import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = {
    "source0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_0.csv",
    "source1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_1.csv",
    "source2": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_2.csv",
    "source3": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_3.csv",
    "source4": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_4.csv",
    "source5": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_5.csv",
    "source6": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_6.csv",
    "source7": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_7.csv",
    "source8": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_8.csv",
    "source9": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/training_9.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source0"], index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source1"], index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source2"], index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source3"], index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source4"], index_col=0)
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source5"], index_col=0)
df6 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source6"], index_col=0)
df7 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source7"], index_col=0)
df8 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source8"], index_col=0)
df9 = pd.read_csv(source_files["source9"], index_col=0)

# Step 2: Union all source tables that share the same schema as source0:
# Source0, Source1, Source8, Source9 have the same schema:
# ['CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED', 'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP']
df_dim_list = [df0, df1, df8, df9]
df_dim = pd.concat(df_dim_list, ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: Join all other source tables (aspect tables) on ROW_WID with the unioned dimension table
# Source2: ['ROW_WID', 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM']
# Source3: ['ROW_WID', 'KEYWORDS_NUM']
# Source4: ['ROW_WID', 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM']  <-- contains the target column
# Source5: ['ROW_WID', 'INTERACTIONS_NUM']
# Source6: ['ROW_WID', 'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM']
# Source7: ['ROW_WID', 'VISITS_NUM']

# We join all aspect tables on ROW_WID with df_dim (dimension table)
# Start with df_dim, then left join each aspect table on ROW_WID

df_merged = df_dim.copy()

# Join Source2
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df2, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join Source3
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df3, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join Source4 (contains TECHSUPPORT_NUM)
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df4, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join Source5
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df5, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join Source6
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df6, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join Source7
df_merged = df_merged.merge(df7, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Step 4: Extract the target column TECHSUPPORT_NUM from the merged dataframe
# According to the target schema, only TECHSUPPORT_NUM (integer) is needed

# TECHSUPPORT_NUM may have missing values if no match in Source4, drop rows without TECHSUPPORT_NUM
df_target = df_merged[["TECHSUPPORT_NUM"]].dropna()

# Convert TECHSUPPORT_NUM to integer type (as target schema requires integer)
df_target["TECHSUPPORT_NUM"] = df_target["TECHSUPPORT_NUM"].astype(int)

# Step 5: Save the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_35/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
